title: [ZoomIt] Build the precompiled header once so sources compile in parallel

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The project now has a single PCH producer, pch.cpp, and uses that PCH by default across the six Debug/Release and Win32/x64/ARM64 configurations. The retained NotUsing settings are scoped to individual compilation items; they do not disable PCH for the entire x64 configuration. The removed AudioSampleGenerator/LoopbackCapture overrides and their source includes agree with the intended change.

**Validation scope:** Exact-head project XML, producer/consumer metadata and relevant source includes were checked. No native build, execution or benchmark measurement was performed here, so the author-reported performance improvement is not independently certified. No code change is requested by this qualified assessment; it is not an unconditional approval.
